_meta.note: Created by SCP-G3-EXEC-01 as the synthetic InStore generalization market (G3-F). It exists to prove the Service-Commerce Kernel is topology- and tenant-neutral: a DIFFERENT tenant, a DIFFERENT topology (INSTORE rather than Freshline's MOBILE), a DIFFERENT currency, billing series, operating policy and pricing, all reached through the same kernel with no Core fork and no Freshline/Bali literal. Nothing here is a real business configuration and no deployment is implied.
assumptions: tenantId 'northbeam' — a synthetic tenant distinct from 'freshline', so cross-tenant refusal is provable rather than asserted
topology INSTORE only — the customer travels to a physical location; this is the deliberate inverse of Bali's MOBILE-only configuration
billing.codePattern uses an NB- series so no Freshline FL- literal can satisfy this market
currency VND with 0 decimal digits — chosen to differ from both IDR and THB
operatingHours and bookingWindow deliberately differ from both Freshline markets so a Core constant could not satisfy all three
offer.validityMinutes and capacityHoldTtlMinutes differ from Freshline so offer/hold expiry is provably config-derived
